title: Giuliano Caprile (Eger) to Bonaventura Pistofilo, 9 March 1519: the 1519 two-tier cipher, ASMo Ambasciatori Ungheria b. 4 (DECODE R1128; catalogue 157)

documents.shelfmark: ASMo, Ambasciatori, Ungheria b. 4, Caprili 1519-20 no. 1 (DECODE R1128; Vestigia 1853)

transcription.source: DECODE image IMG_R1128_I5713_P1, column transcription (upper sign/base sign, bracket codes) in t1519.txt
transcription.notes: Nine lines, 183 columns of 78 types, 39 of them bracket-L code words; counted from t1519.txt by script (lines R1128).

system.summary: Two-tier cipher: a small sign over a base stroke (7, m, n, a, t, 4), with bracket-L signs for whole words.
system.sibling_key: R1129-R1135 (Caprili 1519-20 nos. 3a-8a, 10a), same cipher, deciphered in 1882 (b/c copies on Vestigia) or interlined: key material, not yet rebuilt
system.notes: Two analyses disagree: R1133/7c gave one letter per column (fixed1519.json), R1130/4c a syllabary, upper = consonant, base = vowel (pairX/key.json); the factorised rebuild (syl_fact.py) learns the base tier only. distinct_symbols = column types in R1128.

prior_solution.where: none for R1128; the sibling letters R1129-R1135 in the same cipher were deciphered in 1882 (filed as b/c) or interlined

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: DECODE R1126-R1140 metadata and images; Vestigia searches Caprile (52) and Cistarelli (20); contact sheets. R1128 and R1129-R1135 are in the 1519 two-tier cipher.
Vestigia: 1519 cipher originals filed as 'a' with 'b'/'c' clear copies; ASMo inventory dates them to 1882. R1129-R1135 read at the time or in 1882.

R1130 (no. 4a) aligned with its 1882 decipherment 4c (pairX/): the 1519 cipher is syllabic, upper sign = consonant, base = vowel (7 none, m e, n o), bracket-L = CV syllables; about 20 values, held-out 16/18 against 8.1 shuffled. R1131/5b alignment failed (water stain).

R1128's 1519 two-tier system: R1133 transcribed in full (1327 columns) and aligned with its 1882 decipherment 7c; one letter per column, homophonic (c/7=o, m/n=r, x/7=t ...); bracket-L signs are nomenclator words ([d][s][&] = de vostra maesta).
Language-model anneal over the 1519 columns with 9 fixed values; R1128 (21% code words) not read.

Known keys on R1128 (knownkeys.py): pairX syllabary from R1130/4c covers 32 % of columns, LM -3.22 vs -3.24 for a random key with the same values; fixed1519 covers 13 %; key1519_ann is fitted on R1128 (no evidence).

R1128: factorised syllabary (column = consonant of the upper sign + vowel of the base) trained by hard EM on R1130/4c and R1133/7c (syl_fact.py); base tier learns cleanly (7 = none, m = e, n = o) but the upper tier does not (most uppers map to '' as often as to a consonant); R1128 beam decode scores LM -2.92/char against -2.41 for the same tables permuted, i.e. worse than the control: not read.

Entry split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026) from caprile1519, which had joined three ciphers of the same ASMo file: the 1519 two-tier cipher (caprile1519), the 1520-21 sign cipher (caprile1520) and Cistarelli's figure cipher (cistarelli1520). This profile keeps the documents and steps of the 1519 two-tier cipher (R1128, with R1129-R1135 as key material) only.

outcome.method_basis: R1128 has no decipherment; the 1519 tables rebuilt from the sibling decipherments (R1133/7c, R1130/4c) give no signal on it against random-key and permuted controls, and the factorised syllabary rebuild failed.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No column of R1128 is claimed as read (knownkeys.py r1128, syl_fact.py).
outcome.notes: Attempted, open. The key material exists: R1129-R1135 in the same cipher were deciphered in 1882 (b/c copies) or interlined, so the gap is work (a careful transcription of R1132 against 6b and R1131 against 5b), not an outside blocker. Split 14 Oct 2026 from caprile1519, which also held the 1520-21 sign cipher (now caprile1520) and Cistarelli's figures (now cistarelli1520).

gaps.detail: workable, left open: attempted 21 Sept and 2 Oct 2026; the 1519 tables give no signal; key rebuildable from the 1882 sibling decipherments (R1131/5b, R1132/6b)

credits.note: 1882 decipherments and interlinear glosses of the sibling letters R1129-R1135, used as cribs for the 1519 tables
